title: Baltic & Finland Vessel Port Calls & Port Congestion (Digitraffic) Input

modes.title: Output modes
modes.description: Select output modes: port_calls (individual vessel port calls) and/or port_congestion_summary (aggregated per-port traffic & turnaround stats).

ports.title: Port UN/LOCODE filter (empty = all ports)
ports.description: Filter by port UN/LOCODEs (e.g. FIHEL Helsinki, FITKU Turku, FIHKO Hanko, FIKTK Kotka, FIRAU Rauma, FIOUL Oulu). Leave empty for all ports.

cargoOnly.title: Cargo vessels only
cargoOnly.description: When true, filters to port calls where arrivalWithCargo is true.

vesselQuery.title: Vessel name, IMO, or callsign search (optional)
vesselQuery.description: Optional substring filter matching vesselName, IMO number, or radio callsign.

maxResults.title: Max port call records
maxResults.description: Maximum number of individual port_call records to output.
